Name: MH Custom Categories
Author: mahsouto
Description:
[size=6][b][center]MH Custom Categories[/center][/b][/size][b][center][/center][/b]
A powerful item categorization system that gives you full control over how items are organized in your game. Create custom categories, assign colors, and seamlessly integrate with Categories Chest for the ultimate storage management experience. 

[b]Features
[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]It does not replace native categories[/size]
[/list]
[list]
[*]Intuitive multi-window menu system
[list]
[*]Category Editor: Manage all your custom categories
[*]Category Details: Add/remove items and customize appearance
[*]Item Search: Find any item in the game by name
[*]Color Picker: Choose from 32 colors for visual organization
[*]Quick add: Press a configurable key (default Q) while hovering over an item in your inventory or chest to quickly add it to an existing category
[*]Batch add: Press a configurable key (default Y) while in your inventory or chest to enter batch selection mode. Choose a category, click multiple items to select them, then press the same key again to add all selected items at once
[/list][*]Full integration with Categories Chest
[list]
[*]Custom categories appear in chest filters
[*]Items automatically sorted based on your rules
[*]Real-time updates without game restart
[/list][*]Advanced customization options
[list]
[*]Assign multiple categories to a single item
[*]Custom colors for each category displayed in tooltips
[*]Enable/disable categories without deleting them
[*]Support for vanilla and modded items
[/list][/list]

[size=5][b]How to Use
[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Press F6 (or your configured key) to open the Category Editor
[*]Create a new category with a custom name and color
[*]Click on a category to view its details
[*]Add items using the search function or by entering item IDs
[*]Enable/disable categories as needed
[*]Open a Categories Chest to see your custom organization in action!
[/list]

[/size][/b]
